class.name: YAMLResult
class.brief_description: Contains the results or errors from YAML operations.
class.description:
Contains the results from YAML parsing or emitting operations, providing a unified interface for both successful data and error cases. This class serves as a return type for API methods, containing either the parsed/emitted data or error information. [YAMLResult] objects are immutable and can contain either successful data or error information, but not both. When an operation succeeds, the result contains the data and no error. When an operation fails, the result contains error information and empty data. Multi-document YAML is fully supported, allowing you to access each document individually through [method get_document] or [method get_data] with an index parameter. [b]Basic Usage Example:[/b] [codeblock lang=gdscript] # Parse a YAML file and handle the result var result = YAML.load_file("res://data/level_data.yaml")
if result.has_error(): push_error("YAML parsing failed: " + result.get_error()) return
# Success - get the data and use it var level_data = result.get_data() print("Loaded level: " + level_data.name) spawn_enemies(level_data.enemies) [/codeblock]
